observations: Photo 0: Canon EOS 600D body with rear body cap on, 'Canon EOS 600D' badge visible on front
Photo 0: Separate EF-S 18-55mm lens with front and rear caps on, 'Canon EFS 18-55mm' text visible on barrel
Photo 0: Neck strap printed 'Canon EOS Digital' lying behind the body
Photo 1: Rear of the same 600D showing flip-out LCD screen (closed/folded against body), control buttons, mode dial, visible 'EOS' marking on side
Photo 2: Same 600D plus lens shown again, but also a second camera body labeled 'Canon EOS 700D' with a different lens, and a Nikon lens cap visible top of frame, all on the same shelf
No photo shows a battery, charger, SD card, battery compartment, or the bare lens glass (front/rear caps are on in every shot)
No screenshot of shutter count software (e.g. EOSInfo, shutter count app) is shown
LCD screen is not shown powered on; no test image or live view visible
Seller's new message is text only, repeating the original claims with no new photo or screenshot attached

claims.evidence: No origin sticker, import label, or UK-specific marking visible in any photo
Body looks cosmetically clean in photos 0-2, but 'sharp' (image quality) cannot be judged without a sample photo
Seller now says 'I tested it myself yesterday' but sent no screenshot; a verbal claim of self-testing is not photographic proof

claims.claim: no fungus or scratch on the lens
claims.evidence: Lens front and rear caps are on in all three photos; glass elements are never visible
Neither battery nor charger appears in photo 0, 1, or 2
No internal shots, screw marks, or service sticker check possible from exterior photos given

claims.claim: 'everything I said is true, please check again'
claims.evidence: A restated assurance with no new photo or document; text claims are not evidence of themselves

risks.risk: Actual shutter count may be far higher than claimed, affecting shutter life and value
risks.proof: Clear photo/screenshot of shutter count from EOSInfo, Canon menu, or similar tool
risks.if_unproven: priced as high/unknown shutter count (near end-of-life assumption)

risks.risk: Lens may have internal fungus, haze, or scratches hidden by the caps
risks.proof: Close-up photo of lens with caps off, held up to light from both front and rear, plus a test shot
risks.if_unproven: priced as lens condition unknown (possible defect)

risks.risk: Battery and charger may not actually be included despite the claim
risks.proof: Photo showing the battery and charger alongside the camera
risks.if_unproven: priced as body+lens only, no accessories

risks.risk: LCD screen or sensor could be faulty (dead pixels, stuck pixels, hinge damage) since screen is shown closed/off
risks.proof: Photo of the screen powered on showing a live image, and a full-frame test photo straight off the sensor
risks.if_unproven: priced as screen/sensor functionality unverified (worst case: not working)

risks.risk: Seller appears to have multiple similar cameras (600D, 700D) on the same shelf, suggesting a reseller/refurbisher rather than a single personal-use UK import, raising risk of mixed/cannibalized parts
risks.proof: Photo of the specific unit's serial number matching any box, invoice, or UK import documentation
risks.if_unproven: priced as a generic used unit with no verified provenance

proof_requests: Screenshot of shutter count from Canon menu or EOSInfo software for this specific body
Photo of the lens with caps removed, front and back, in good light
Photo of the battery and charger together with the camera
Photo of the LCD screen powered on with a live view or test image
A sample full-resolution photo taken with this exact body and lens
response.reason: A verbal reassurance with no accompanying photo or screenshot does not upgrade any claim's verdict; the item is still priced at worst case as a body-and-lens-only unit with unverified shutter count, lens condition, and accessories.
